title: Privacy-first KMS handoff & SSO federation: phased acceptance schedule and control checklist
creator: Sana Ortega
description: This PRD captures security and compliance acceptance criteria for a privacy-preserving customer key handoff workflow combined with SSO/SAML federation and RBAC mapping for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers. The goal is to provide a reproducible, phased evidence schedule and a control checklist that operations, security, and product can sign off on before GA. This is focused on: (1) customer-managed keys (CMK) + HSM attestations; (2) deterministic SAML federation and group-to-role mapping; (3) immutable audit trails and export to SIEM; (4) limited operator access and clear proofs for audits.
scope_changes: 2025-02-18: Added operator-less HSM escrow option (customer-uploaded sealed key material) — out of scope for initial canary but tracked as phased deliverable.
2025-02-25: Restrict key export APIs to allow only wrapped-export with HSM attest; removed free-form key download for Private customers.
2025-03-05: Expanded SAML requirements to include IdP metadata validation and automated cert rotation acceptance tests.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML 2.0 flows validated end-to-end using a test IdP (Okta and ADFS). Assertions include NameID, email, and groups claim; metadata validation and certificate chain checks pass.

RBAC: Group-to-role mapping applies within 30s of successful SAML assertion; roles defined: owner, admin, operator, auditor, readonly. Permission matrix enforced for API and Console routes; unauthorized access returns 403 with audit id.

KMS/HSM: Customer-managed CMK can be registered via envelope-encryption import or HSM-escrow (phased). Key creation/import, rotate, disable, and schedule-rotate operations emit discrete, signed audit events.

Audit logs: All auth and KMS events include request_id, principal_id, principal_type, source_ip, region, timestamp, action, resource_id, and model_id if applicable. Logs are immutable (append-only storage) and retained for 365 days by default, with export to S3/ELK/Splunk endpoints.

Evidence: For GA, we must have passing results for the Acceptance Test Plan (automated + manual), an internal security review, and a customer-facing onboarding runbook with checklist and sample evidence bundle.
Operator access: No human operator may retrieve plaintext key material. Operator sessions require break-glass justification and produce an elevated-access audit record that is signed and archived.
Rollout gating: Canary with two pilot customers (one SaaS, one regulated) must complete acceptance tests with no critical findings; otherwise rollback to previous model version.
test_scenarios: End-to-end SAML flow from Okta -> Redwood Private control plane -> console sign-in: verify role mapping, session length, and refresh behavior.
CMK import via envelope (customer wraps DEK with KMS public key): perform encrypt/decrypt roundtrip using model inference call to exercise keys and inspect audit entries.
Simulated HSM attest path (phased): verify attestation certificate present and validated during key registration; attempt forbidden key export and confirm denial.
Chaos test: disrupt control-plane region during active sessions and confirm fallback behavior preserves RBAC and audit continuity.
SIEM integration: export audit stream to test Splunk index and verify event schema, field mappings, and alert triggers for suspicious events (multiple failed decrypts, unusual region access).

dependencies: ENG-18360: Runtime change - surface key_id in inference events
ENG-19102: Audit pipeline - append-only logstore retention policy

rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal alpha (limited testIds) -> Phase 1: pilot with 2 customers and manual onboarding -> Phase 2: gradual GA region-by-region with monitoring gates and 72h observation windows. Each phase requires signoff in the signoff_checklist before moving forward.
audit_log_requirements: Event schema v2 (immutable): request_id, timestamp, user_id, principal_type, action, resource_type, resource_id, region, io_bytes, outcome, message_hash.
Retention: default 365 days; support configurable retention per customer via Private Console (min 90d, max 7y).
Tamper evidence: logs write to append-only store with periodic signed manifests (SHA256 + root-key) for auditors.
Export: Push to customer SIEM (S3 bucket with KMS-wrapped objects) and webhook forwarders with HMAC signing.
kms_hsm_requirements: CMK registration: support import via envelope and HSM-attested import (x509 attestation).
Key operations: create, import, rotate, disable, schedule-rotate, rewrap, list, describe. No plaintext export allowed for HSM-backed keys.
Attestation: HSM attestation certificate chain must be validated against an allowlist and surfaced in key metadata.
Rotation: scheduled rotation flows must produce a rotation-event linking old_key_id -> new_key_id and appear in audit logs.
Wrap/Unwrap: server-side unwrap only for runtime usage; customer may request wrapped-export for cross-account transfer under documented governance.
sso_saml_requirements: Metadata ingestion: accept IdP metadata XML and validate cert fingerprints and validity windows.
Cert rotation: automated test harness must prove SP accepts rotated IdP certs with zero-downtime (grace period).
Attributes: require at minimum: email, groups, and NameID. Support custom attribute mappings via console.
Monitoring: track failed assertion rate and alert at >0.5% failure per 5-minute window.
risk_mitigation: Mitigate key-leak risk by design: no operator access to plaintext; automated tests to prove inability to exfiltrate keys.
Fallback: if SAML IdP fails, allow emergency service-account access with limited TTL and elevated audit controls.
Visibility: augment dashboards to show per-customer failed-auth spikes and anomalous key usage patterns.
notes: Prefer envelope import for GA; operator-less HSM escrow will be delivered in Phase 2 as opt-in per-customer functionality.
Coordinate legal review for regional KMS export restrictions (EU data export rules).
Design team to produce a compact onboarding checklist UI to reduce friction for pilot customers.
